rules: no proxy, no credentials, no paid source, no substitution; refused requests are recorded, not retried elsewhere

binance_oi_archive.history: daily files since 2021-12; each day's file is published after the day ends
binance_oi_archive.v1_overlap: none: V1 has no open-interest source
